CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_union_wallet_that_can_pay(p_user_id uuid, p_union_id uuid, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT m.club_id
    FROM public.club_members m
   WHERE m.user_id = p_user_id
     AND m.status IN ('active', 'approved')
     AND p_union_id IS NOT NULL
     AND p_amount IS NOT NULL AND p_amount > 0
     AND COALESCE(m.chip_balance, 0) >= p_amount
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.union_clubs uc
                  WHERE uc.club_id = m.club_id AND uc.union_id = p_union_id)
   ORDER BY m.chip_balance DESC, m.joined_at ASC NULLS LAST, m.club_id
   LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cash_main_chair_is_the_lists(p_table_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.tables mt
      JOIN public.cash_games cg ON cg.id = mt.cluster_id
     WHERE mt.id = p_table_id
       AND mt.role = 'main'
       AND coalesce(cg.handedness, 9) >= 7
       AND cg.must_move
       AND cg.cluster_mode = 'must_move'
       AND NOT public.fn_cash_game_never_moves_players(cg.template_name, cg.ruleset_snapshot)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tables ft
                    WHERE ft.cluster_id = mt.cluster_id AND ft.role = 'feeder'
                      AND ft.lifecycle IN ('live', 'opening')
                      AND coalesce(ft.is_deleted, false) = false
                      AND ft.status IN ('waiting', 'running', 'active')));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cash_rejoin_floor(p_user_id uuid, p_table_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_barred timestamptz;
  v_floor numeric;
BEGIN
  SELECT max(c.barred_until), max(c.required_stack)
    INTO v_barred, v_floor
    FROM public.tables t
    JOIN public.cash_rejoin_constraints c
      ON c.player_id = p_user_id
     AND c.club_id  = t.club_id
     AND c.variant  = t.game_variant
     AND c.sb       = t.small_blind
     AND c.bb       = t.big_blind
     AND c.expires_at > now()
   WHERE t.id = p_table_id
     AND t.tournament_id IS NULL;
  IF v_barred IS NOT NULL AND v_barred > now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VPIP_BARRED:%', ceil(extract(epoch FROM (v_barred - now())))::integer
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation',
            HINT = 'Removed for low VPIP: no seat in this game until the bar lifts.';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_floor;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cash_stay_remaining_ms(p_remaining integer, p_running boolean, p_last_tick timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT 0; $function$
